subject: Box
text: Link can glide with a Cucco to a southwest cliff ledge and roll into the box to obtain a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: With Cucco in hand, jump off the cliff and glide down toward that ledge. When you land, throw the Cucco against the wall in an effort to try and keep it here, then roll into the box and grab the PIECE OF HEART [015].

subject: Soft Soil Hole
text: Releasing bugs over the soft soil hole on the lower ledge causes a Skulltula to emerge, which yields a Gold Skulltula when defeated.

evidence.quote: Release the little bugs on top of the hole and they will crawl into it, after that a Skulltula will jump out. Defeat this enemy and pick up the GOLD SKULLTULA [022].

subject: Waterfall
text: Swimming behind the waterfall to the north leads to a ladder that ascends to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Swim behind the waterfall to the north and in the middle you will come across a ladder leading up. Basically all this does is lead up to a PIECE OF HEART [035] in a small area.

subject: King Zora
text: Presenting the Letter in a bottle to King Zora moves him aside and leaves Link with an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: Stand on the platform in front of him and use the Letter in the bottle. After this is said and done, the king will move, revealing the path to the next dungeon and you will also receive the EMPTY BOTTLE which had the Letter inside.

subject: Tree
text: Rolling into the tree at the southeast corner knocks down a Skulltula that yields a Gold Skulltula when killed.

evidence.quote: Run up to the tree and roll into it, this should knock down yet another Skulltula which you can kill and grab the GOLD SKULLTULA [023].

subject: Great Fairy's Fountain
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem inside the Great Fairy's Fountain grants the Farore's Wind spell.

evidence.quote: Head inside and stand on the Triforce emblem, you need to whip out your Fairy Ocarina and play Zelda's Lullaby. What you learn here for the Great Fairy is a technique called FARORE'S WIND. This technique can be sued to create and warp to warp points in the game's many dungeons.

subject: Octorok
text: Octoroks cannot be killed with a sword, but deflecting their attacks back at them with the Deku Shield will kill them.

evidence.quote: The Octoroks on the other hand (funnel mouthed things that pop out of the water) cannot be killed with your sword, similar to the Deku Scrubs. Remember that you should still have your Deku Shield, equip that now and use it to deflect the attacks of the Octoroks back at them and kill them.

subject: Throat Switch
text: Shooting the dangling object on the ceiling with the Fairy Slingshot opens the door to the next area.

evidence.quote: What you have to do is walk back and equip your Fairy Slingshot. Use it to fire up at that little thing dangling down from the roof of his mouth and the path will open.

subject: Jellyfish
text: Jellyfish enemies hurt Link if attacked normally, but bombs will defeat them.

evidence.quote: The first thing to note in this particular room is that you cannot kill the weird jellyfish things, in fact you will be hurt yourself in the process if you try. Just leave them be for the moment. If for some reason you really want it dead, then bombs will get the job done.

subject: Vine Wall
text: Shooting the Skulltula high on the vine wall with the Fairy Slingshot and raising the water level allows Link to climb up and collect a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: There is a Skulltula on this wall, higher up. Equip your Fairy Slingshot and fire at it until the enemy is dead. Now jump onto the yellow button in the middle and this will raise the water level up. Use this to get high enough to reach the vine, and climb up to acquire GOLD SKULLTULA [024].

subject: Ceiling Button
text: Throwing Princess Ruto into the ceiling button opens the door at the end of the hall.

evidence.quote: In the middle of the hallway just past here, there is a button on the ceiling. No need to equip your Fairy Slingshot, just hurl the princess up there to hit it and open the door at the end of the hall.

subject: Emerging Creatures
text: Charging a Spin Attack until it turns orange will kill the emerging underground creatures in one hit.

evidence.quote: Long creatures which pop out of the ground and chase after you. The normal sword is ineffective but I find that if you use the charge up Spin Attack, to the point where it goes orange, it will kill them in one hit, and maybe more than one of them at a time.

subject: Chest
text: Defeating the four aquatic enemies using two Slingshot shots in the air or one bomb underground spawns a large chest containing the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: There are two methods of dealing with them that work that I know of: first of all, if they are floating in the air then stand back and fire at them with your Fairy Slingshot. Doing this requires you to hit them two times. If they are swimming underground then stand back and throw bombs at them, this will kill them in a single hit. Once all four of the enemies have been dispatched, a large chest appears at the centre of the room. Open this chest to acquire the BOOMERANG.

subject: Blue Button
text: To keep the blue switch depressed and the door open, jump onto the button while holding Ruto and set her down before stepping off.

evidence.quote: On the opposite side there is a blue button which opens the door into the next room. If you jump off this button then the door will close again. The solution is as follows: hold Ruto over your head and jump onto the button. Before getting off of it, put her down and then get off, it will stay down.

subject: Chest
text: Targeting the descending enemy with the Boomerang defeats it in four hits and reveals a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: The solution is to get close and use L/Z targeting immediately right when it is coming down to hit it, before it hits you. After four hits the enemy is defeated and another large chest appears in this room. Open the treasure chest to acquire the DUNGEON MAP for this dungeon.

subject: Chest
text: Defeating all bubbles within forty seconds reveals a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: You have forty seconds to defeat all of the bubbles in this room, you can throw the princess at them, you can throw your Boomerang at them, you can even just run into them like an idiot but I find the most effective method of dealing with them is to just use the good old fashioned sword. Once they have all been defeated within the time limit, a large chest will appear in the middle of the room containing the COMPASS for the dungeon.

subject: Wall
text: Defeating the closest Skulltula on the wall allows Link to retrieve a Gold Skulltula using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Equip your Boomerang and aim it at the enemy closest to you on the wall. After it has been defeated you can throw the Boomerang and it will retrieve the GOLD SKULLTULA [025] for you.

subject: Wall
text: Shooting the farther Skulltula to the right with the Boomerang allows Link to retrieve another Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Aim right and there is another Skulltula further away, shoot it with the Boomerang and use it to collect the GOLD SKULLTULA [026].
